dec.n: Ahmadou Sadio Diallo (Guinea v. Democratic Republic of the Congo)
dec.pe: A businessman from Guinea who had lived in Congo for 32 years was arrested and expelled after a business dispute. The International Court of Justice found Congo broke international law.
dec.pi: Seorang pengusaha dari Guinea yang 32 tahun tinggal di Kongo ditangkap dan diusir setelah sengketa bisnis. Mahkamah Internasional menyatakan Kongo melanggar hukum internasional.
